title: Filter thickness exceptions 1
scenario: An invented pipe-inspection register has 20 separate measurements. Several records share a heat, but every record must remain independently traceable. All records and limits are fictitious training assumptions.

lesson.intro: FILTER returns records meeting an aligned Boolean mask. Multiplication combines AND conditions. Check ISNUMBER so a missing measurement cannot be treated as zero. Leave the entire spill area empty before entering the formula.

formulas.name: FILTER
formulas.explanation: array is the returned range; include is an aligned TRUE/FALSE mask. Optional if_empty defines the no-match result.

formulas.name: ISNUMBER
formulas.explanation: value is tested for a numeric type. Numeric zero is TRUE; empty/text inputs are FALSE.

task.prompt: Return only Record_no values whose Thickness_mm is numeric and strictly below the training threshold 12 mm. Equality is excluded; numeric zero is included and blanks are excluded. Keep source order and all qualifying records even when heats repeat. Spill one formula from B2. Do not round or add a header; if a future dataset has no matches, return the single text None. Return 8 rows × 1 column, without a header, in Answers!B2:B9. Use an Excel formula; any equivalent approach is accepted. Submit the formula and the complete output.

columns.name: Thickness_mm
columns.description: Numeric thickness in mm. Empty means missing; zero is a recorded training measurement.
